# Bulk RNA-seq and eQTL Validation Contract

## Simulation Truth

- Donor genotypes, gene/annotation source, baseline expression, cis/trans eQTL
  effects, condition and genotype-by-condition effects, batch labels, latent
  factors, allele-specific-expression effects, dispersion/noise settings, and seed.

## Required Results

- Count and expression matrices, gene and sample metadata, condition/batch and
  latent-factor truth, eQTL/ASE truth TSVs, eQTL results and benchmark TSVs,
  plus a parameter manifest.

## Required Figures

- Library-size and mean-variance plots.
- Sample PCA/MDS coloured by condition and batch.
- Differential-expression volcano plot when DE is run.
- eQTL signal/recovery plot and allelic-ratio-by-genotype plot when ASE is simulated.

## Pass Criteria

- Counts are non-negative integers and sample/gene identifiers align across files.
- Conditions, replicates, batches, and donor identifiers match their truth metadata.
- Dispersion, library size, and zero fraction are reported rather than assumed.
- eQTL/DE recovery is evaluated against explicit simulated truth; report precision,
  recall, and FDR/power at a prespecified threshold.
